description:
Live traffic speed against free-flow speed on the road nearest
    each point, anywhere in the US (TomTom). Use it for "is the bridge
    backed up right now"; for a whole drive, plan_trip is better.

center.description: Exact 'lat,lon' instead of a place name, e.g. '47.6097,-122.3421'. Wins over the place name.
center.title: Center

place.description: An address, landmark or place anywhere in the US, e.g. '1600 Pennsylvania Ave, Washington DC' or 'Pike Place Market'. Include city and state when you have them. 'home', 'work' or a saved place's name use the user's saved places (see get_my_places). Leave origin out to start from the user's Home.
place.title: Place
